entries.title: Tell HN: How 2 devs got 1 million monthly actives with no social/viral tools
entries.author: philippb
entries.current_title: Tell HN: How 2 devs got 1 million monthly actives with no social/viral tools
entries.excerpt: KeepSafe lets you take control of who sees what on your phone. Privacy is our main feature so we're an inherently non-social service. 12 months ago, we started at 0, today we have more than a million daily active users. entries.guide_zh: KeepSafe 团队称不用社交传播工具，也靠两名开发者做到百万月活。
